title: Flow Double-Click Add Node
description: Double-click flow canvas to search functions, preview ghost node with highlight, Enter to add top suggestion, chevron for full list with hover preview.
summary: Implemented flow canvas spotlight: double-click opens search overlay with ranked catalogue suggestions, chevron expands full list, hover/arrow keys preview candidates as accent-highlighted ghost nodes on the WASM canvas, Enter or click commits via addWidget. Rust: DagHost::paint_ghost_node, FlowHost ghost_node state with set/clear_ghost_widget and widget_from_descriptor refactor, FlowSession WASM bindings. React: flowRankCatalogueSuggestions, FlowSpotlight in FlowCanvas. Tests: flow core 15 pass, flow react 18 pass. WASM rebuilt.
